notes: TWO folded thicknesses are published, split by colour variant (not hinge/non-hinge side): Ivory White Version folded 8.8 mm / unfolded 4.1 mm @ approx. 217 g, Other Version folded 9 mm / unfolded 4.2 mm @ approx. 222 g. Per the larger-value rule the Other Version figures are recorded (9 / 4.2 / 222 g); 8.8 mm / 217 g is the figure HONOR markets. HONOR's global page prints "9 mm"; HONOR's China spec page prints the same value as "9.0 mm" (https://www.honor.com/cn/phones/honor-magic-v5/spec/, "折叠态：9.0 mm"), which also independently confirms 156.8 / 74.3 / 145.9 / 4.2 mm and 217 g / 222 g. No hinge-side value is published so depth_at_hinge is null. Height 156.8 mm is published as one value for both states. hinge.crease is null: HONOR calls this the "HONOR Mortise and Tenon Dampening Hinge" / "ultra-durable shield-grade steel hinge" and makes no water-drop/teardrop or U-crease claim on either the global or the China page. hinge.free_stop is null: unlike the Magic V2 and V3 pages, neither the global nor the China Magic V5 page makes any hover / free-stop / multi-angle claim - not asserted rather than denied. Display aspect ratios are not published for this model - left null. materials.frame null: no frame material is stated on any HONOR page for this model (the China page says only "8.8mm 超轻薄机身", "8.8 mm ultra-thin body"). resolution_px recorded in HONOR's printed order (long axis first). active_area_mm left null - HONOR states the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements and the actual viewable area is slightly smaller. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
